versions.changelog:
## More to Say 1.0

First release.

- Linus and Willy have 12 new lines each: one per season for meeting them, one for a rainy or snowy day (from 2 hearts) and one for a closer friendship (from 6 hearts).
- Each line is said once, in their own voice, without replacing any of their usual dialogue.
- Lines only talk about things you already know at that friendship level.

## More to Say 1.1

Now in German too.

- All 24 new lines of Linus and Willy are translated into German, with the same portraits and pauses. Players with the game set to German hear them in German; everyone else keeps the English lines.
- Same topics, same timing, nothing else changes.

## More to Say 1.2

Pam and Gus join in.

- Pam and Gus have 12 new lines each: one per season for meeting them, one for a rainy or snowy day (from 2 hearts) and one for a closer friendship (from 6 hearts).
- Pam talks about parsnips, her stiff old legs and Penny; Gus about his kitchen, the seasons' best ingredients and the Saloon.
- Each line is said once, in their own voice, and only mentions what you already know at that friendship level.
- All 24 new lines are in English and German, like the rest of the pack.
- Linus and Willy are unchanged: same lines, same timing.

## More to Say 1.3

Marnie and Robin join in.

- Marnie and Robin have 12 new lines each: one per season for meeting them, one for a rainy or snowy day (from 2 hearts) and one for a closer friendship (from 6 hearts).
- Marnie talks about her animals, hay for the winter and Jas; Robin about building, wood and stone, and life up on the mountain.
- Each line is said once, in their own voice, and only mentions what you already know at that friendship level.
- All 24 new lines are in English and German, like the rest of the pack.
- Linus, Willy, Pam and Gus are unchanged: same lines, same timing.

## More to Say 1.4

Evelyn, George and the Wizard join in.

- Evelyn, George and the Wizard have 12 new lines each: one per season for meeting them, one for a rainy or snowy day (from 2 hearts) and one for a closer friendship (from 6 hearts).
- Evelyn talks about the town gardens, her seasonal cookies and George; George about his television, leeks and the cold; the Wizard about the elementals, the forest and the mysteries around us.
- Each line is said once, in their own voice, and only mentions what you already know at that friendship level.
- All 36 new lines are in English and German, like the rest of the pack.
- Linus, Willy, Pam, Gus, Marnie and Robin are unchanged: same lines, same timing.
